title: Mitigating Biases to Embrace Diversity: A Comprehensive Annotation Benchmark for Toxic Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating inter-annotator agreement and fine-tuned BERT model performance on toxic language datasets containing African American English (AAE) and casual slang to measure the reduction in misclassification of non-mainstream language varieties.

Comparing inter-annotator reliability metrics (Cohen's Kappa and Gwet's AC1) between human annotators and Large Language Models (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) under unstructured (descriptive) versus criteria-based (prescriptive) annotation guidelines.
